model: Ceres GT Steel Gravel Frame Kit – Acqua Bella
description:
The Tout Terrain Ceres GT is a high-performance steel frame gravel bike engineered for ultra-distance adventures and fast gravel racing. This is our sportiest frame to date, combining the legendary resilience and comfort of a Tout Terrain Thermocrom steel frame with a modern, race-inspired geometry.
Key features

Speed and agility: improved acceleration, vibration-dampening comfort and an aerodynamic riding position, ideal for all-day, high-pace rides

Ready for bikepacking: 4 mounting points on the frame for bags, extra bottles and essential gear. Fork mounts depend on the fork you choose; the Tout Terrain Gravel Fork adds 3 replaceable bottle bosses per leg

Thermocrom steel: the resilience and ride comfort Tout Terrain frames are known for

Integrated cable routing for a clean, protected setup
T47 threaded bottom bracket

Sizes: S, M, L and XL

Build options
This listing is for the Ceres GT frame kit in Acqua Bella. Choose frame only, or add the Tout Terrain Gravel Fork or the Cane Creek Invert SL 700c fork, and the SRAM Mullet AXS drivetrain kit.
